Package io.github.jspinak.brobot.control

Class ExecutionPauseController

java.lang.Object
io.github.jspinak.brobot.control.ExecutionPauseController
@Component public class ExecutionPauseController extends Object
Manages execution pausing and resuming for debugging purposes. Allows setting breakpoints and pausing execution at specific points.
